name: Pocatello Potato Palooza 2026

venue.name: Idaho State University Pond Student Union Building

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full). If you are new to competing, please refer to the Newcomer Information tab. For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the Registration and Waitlist Info tab. Go to our [website](https://utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group, Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
